name: Komachi
source: Komachi is a female junior college student who is narrow-minded when it comes to love. Her days are always filled with bewilderment thanks to her awakening feelings of love for the exorbitant Takaomi. When Komachi was younger she constantly had to protect her younger brother from the neighborhood bullies, and her continued fighting against them helped to polish her hard hitting right punch.
